props.name: Sedgewick Building
props.about: The Sedgewick Building (SED) houses administrative offices, including Equity and Human Rights, Communications + Marketing and Human Resources

props.name: ( Student ) Health and Wellness Building
props.about: The Health and Wellness Building houses the CUPE bargaining units and technology-based companies that work with UVic’s research community.

props.name: Centennial Stadium
props.about: The stadium holds sporting events and school meets for students from Victoria and around the province.

props.name: Medical Science Building
props.about: The Medical Sciences Building (MSB) is the home of the Island Medical Program (IMP) and the Division of Medical Sciences.

props.name: Engineering and Computer Science Building
props.about: The Engineering & Computer Science Building (ECS) is the home of UVic's departments of Computer Science and Civil Engineering.

props.name: Petch Building
props.about: The Petch Building (PCH) is home to the Department of Biochemistry and Microbiology, the Centre for Biomedical Research and the Science Store.

props.name: Cunningham Building
props.about: The Cunningham Building (CUN) is the home of the Department of Biology and the Centre for Forest Biology.

props.name: Elliott Building
props.about: The Elliott Building (ELL) is the home of the Faculty of Science and departments of Chemistry, Physics and Astronomy.

props.name: Maclaurin Building
props.about: MacLaurin (MAC) is home to the Faculty of Education and School of Music. It houses the David Lam Auditorium and Phillip T. Young recital hall.

props.name: Clearihue Building
props.about: The Clearihue Building (CLE) is home to UVic’s Faculty of Humanities. It also houses the Computer Help Desk

props.name: Jamie Cassels Centre
props.about: Jamie Cassels Centre (JCC) is home to services for students including Student Awards & Financial Aid, Registrar's Office, Graduate Studies, the Welcome Centre. It also houses the Farquhar Auditorium.

props.name: Cornett Building
props.about: The Cornett Building (COR) is home to the departments of Anthropology, Indigenous studies, Psychology and Sociology, and the Office of Interdisciplinary Academic Programs.

props.name: Mckinnon Building
props.about: The McKinnon Building (MCK) is the home of Exercise Science, Physical and Health Education and the UVic Sports Hall of Fame.

props.name: Human & Social Development Building
props.about: The Human and Social Development Building (HSD) is home to Child and Youth Care, Nursing, Social Work, Health Information Science, and Public Administration, Indigenous Governance and Public Health and Social Policy.

props.name: Outdoor Aquatic Unit
props.about: The Outdoor Aquatic Unit (OAU) has laboratories, aquatic animal holding facilities and a water treatment building. It's maintained by Animal Care Services.

props.name: Hickman Building
props.about: The Hickman Building (HHB) is home to Learning and Teaching Support and Innovation (LTSI).

props.name: Harry Lou-Poy Child Care Centre
props.about: The Lou-Poy Child Care Centre (HLP) is a facility for infant and toddler daycare as part of UVic’s Child Care Services.

props.name: Ian Stewart Complex
props.about: The Ian Stewart Complex (ISC) houses departments from UVic's External Relations, such as Alumni Relations and Development and Donor Relations.

props.name: David Strong Building
props.about: The David Strong Building (DSB) is a classroom focused building which includes Mathews and McQueen auditorium.

props.name: Hut Q
props.about: UVic’s "huts" are the last remnants of the Gordon Head army camp that existed until the 1950s. They now house research centres and university offices.

props.name: Hut Y
props.about: UVic’s "huts" are the last remnants of the Gordon Head army camp that existed until the 1950s. They now house research centres and university offices.

props.name: Bookstore
props.about: The Campus Services Building (CSR) houses Career Services, the Centre for Accessible Learning and the UVic Bookstore.

props.name: Multifaith Centre
props.about: The Multifaith Centre (CHA) is part of Multifaith Services. It's a tranquil place for religious ceremonies, weddings and special gatherings.

props.name: Halpern Centre For Graduate Students
props.about: The Halpern Centre for Graduate Students (GSC) is home of the Graduate Students’ Society, the Grad House Restaurant and Side Project Coffee.

props.name: The SUB
props.about: The Student Union Building (SUB) is home to the University of Victoria Students’ Society (UVSS). It has food outlets, businesses, services and advocacy groups.

props.name: Craigdarroch Office Building
props.about: The Craigdarroch Office Building houses Residence Services.

props.name: Business and Economics Building
props.about: The Business and Economics Building (BEC) is home to the Gustavson School of Business and the Department of Economics.

props.name: Engineering Laboratory Wing
props.about: The Engineering Lab Wing (ELW) houses teaching labs for the Faculty of Engineering and the Nibbles & Bytes Café.

props.name: Engineering Office Wing
props.about: The Engineering Office Wing (EOW) is home to the Faculty of Engineering and the departments of Biomedical, Mechanical, Software and Electrical and Computer Engineering.

props.name: Fine Arts Building
props.about: The Fine Arts Building is the home of the Faculty of Fine Arts and departments of Writing, Film Studies and Art History & Visual Studies.

props.name: University Club
props.about: The University Club of Victoria (UCL) is a members club ideal for dining, meetings, business or relaxation.

props.name: Hut B
props.about: UVic’s "huts" are the last remnants of the Gordon Head army camp that existed until the 1950s. They now house research centres and university offices.

props.name: Saunders Annex
props.about: The Saunders Annex (SAA) houses the Centre for Indigenous Research and Community-Led Engagement, UVic Mail Services, Printing Services and Purchasing Services.

props.name: Saunders Building And Shops
props.about: The Saunders Building (SAU) houses UVic’s Department of Facilities Management.

props.name: Hut R
props.about: UVic’s "huts" are the last remnants of the Gordon Head army camp that existed until the 1950s. They now house research centres and university offices.

props.name: Visual Arts
props.about: The Visual Arts Building (VIA) is the home of the Department of Visual Arts. It contains classrooms, offices and studio and gallery spaces.

props.name: University House 1
props.about: University House 1 (UH1) houses the Pacific Climate Impacts Consortium (PCIC) and the Pacific Institute for Climate Solutions (PICS).

props.name: University House 4
props.about: University House 4 (UH4) is home to various offices of the Faculty of Social Sciences.

props.name: University House 2
props.about: University House 2 (UH2) houses the UVic Faculty Association.

props.name: University House 3
props.about: University House 3 (UH3) houses the Centre for Youth and Society.

props.name: Campus Security Building
props.about: The Campus Security Building (SEC) is home to UVic’s Campus Security Services. This is where you handle parking related matters.

props.name: Hut E
props.about: UVic’s "huts" are the last remnants of the Gordon Head army camp that existed until the 1950s. They now house research centres and university offices.

props.name: McPherson Library
props.fullName: William C. Mearns Centre for Learning | McPherson Library
props.about: The McPherson Library (LIB) contains UVic’s library holdings, the Mearns Centre for Learning, archives, special collections and the map library.

props.name: Hut A
props.about: UVic’s "huts" are the last remnants of the Gordon Head army camp that existed until the 1950s. They now house research centres and university offices.

props.name: David Turpin Building
props.about: The David Turpin Building (DTB) is the home of the departments of Geography, Environmental Studies, Mathematics and Statistics and Political Science.

props.name: Michael Williams Building
props.about: The Michael Williams Building (MWB) accommodates the university's executive team and many services including Research, Accounting, Pension and more.

props.name: First Peoples House
props.about: The First Peoples House (FPH) is home to the Office of Indigenous Academic & Community Engagement, Indigenous Student Services, Indigenous Counselling and LE,NOṈET.

props.name: Bob Wright Centre
props.fullName: Bob Wright Centre - Ocean, Earth and Atmospheric Sciences
props.about: Bob Wright Centre (BWC) is home to the School of Earth and Ocean Sciences, the UVic telescope and the Canadian Centre for Climate Modelling and Analysis (CCCMA).

props.name: Continuing Studies Building
props.about: The Continuing Studies Building (CST) is home to the Division of Continuing Studies and the English Language Centre.

props.name: Phoenix Building
props.about: The Phoenix Theatre (PNX) is the home of UVic's Department of Theatre.

props.name: District Energy Plant
props.about: The District Energy Plant contains heating infrastructure for the University of Victoria

props.name: Child Care Complex
props.about: The Child Care Complex (CCC) provides child care for children over three years of age.

props.name: Čeqʷəŋín ʔéʔləŋ | Cheko’nien House
props.about: Čeqʷəŋín ʔéʔləŋ (Cheko’nien House) opened in September 2022 and contains student residences, a dining hall, study rooms, community kitchen and multi-purpose lounge.

props.name: Sŋéqə ʔéʔləŋ | Sngequ House
props.about: Sŋéqə ʔéʔləŋ (Sngequ House) features a mix of single-person dorm rooms and pod communities with shared kitchen and living spaces.  There are also lecture halls and conference facilities in the lower levels of the building.

props.name: Centre For Athletics, Recreation And Special Abilities
props.fullName: Centre For Athletics, Recreation And Special Abilities
props.about: Centre for Athletics, Recreation and Special Abilities (CARSA) is the home of the University of Victoria’s Vikes and UVic Athletics. It's UVic's primary gym.

props.name: Campus Community Garden
props.about: The Campus Community Garden offers free workshops, events, and a place for everyone to gather. CCG Staff and volunteers work together to grow fresh, organic fruits and vegetables for the UVIC community.

props.name: Glover Greenhouse
props.about: The Glover Greenhouse Facility (GGF) researches forest regeneration and biotechnology with the Centre for Forest Biology.

props.name: National Centre for Indigenous Laws
props.about: The Murray and Anne Fraser Building houses the Faculty of Law and the Diana M. Priestly Law Library. Its new National Centre for Indigenous Laws provides culturally appropriate spaces for learning, like classrooms, a wellness suite, among other spaces.
